# Restack

> > Open-source enterprise platform for designing, testing, and deploying AI agents at scale across multiple cloud providers.

Restack is a comprehensive AI agent platform built for product and engineering teams to build, optimize, and operate production-ready agents. The platform supports multi-cloud deployment on AWS, Azure, and GCP with infrastructure built on Kubernetes, and includes tools for A/B testing, observability, and workflow orchestration.

## Key Topics

- AI agents
- Enterprise-scale deployment
- Kubernetes
- Multi-cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Agent design and optimization
- A/B testing
- Workflow orchestration
- Production deployment
- Open-source framework
- Python/TypeScript support
- Observability
- Temporal workflow engine
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- POC program
- Agent comparison
